title: Product Compliance Engineer
teaser: We are looking for a Product Compliance Engineer to support the development and certification of Cisco video products. You will focus on safety, EMC, and radio functionality, working on compliance tests and ensuring global product certification. Ideal candidates have significant experience in product compliance and a strong background in engineering.
description:
This position offers hybrid work requiring three days of in-office attendance per week (Lysaker, Norway).

Upon applying, please upload your CV in English, and university grade transcript.

Meet the Team

As a global technology leader, Cisco has been redefining how people connect, communicate, and collaborate for decades. At Cisco Norway we focus on Collaboration by designing video devices, desktop systems and digital whiteboards all packed in powerful, sustainable and beautiful products.

Located just outside of Oslo, our Devices innovation center is home to 300+ passionate engineers working across hardware, software, mechanics, audio, media processing and artificial intelligence – from concept to product. We strive to develop best-in-class video conferencing experiences by bringing together diverse engineering teams under one roof.

The Cisco Lysaker Compliance team is looking for a compliance engineer with experience in safety, EMC, radio and sustainable design, testing and certification. You will join a team with expert compliance engineers and also be part of multi-functional project teams developing the next Cisco collaboration products, from early sketches to market-ready product.

Your Impact

You are an enthusiastic and skilled engineer who loves to work on high quality communication products. You are a teammate who challenges the status quo with creation and innovation. It's in your nature to figure things out by yourself, as well as participate in our friendly and team-oriented collaboration environment to learn from others. All of that enables you to ensure the quality that brings our new products securely to market – and keep them there!

 

In this role, you will:

Work on development of Cisco video products, with focus on their safety, EMC and radio functionality.

Perform the relevant compliance tests on prototypes in our internal labs.

Be responsible for a product's global certification, both before and after market launch.

 

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor of Science + 5 years of related experience.

Experience with product approval/certification.

Fluent in English.

 

Preferred Qualifications

Product design and test based on standards IEC 62368-1 (or 60950-1) for safety, EN 55032/35 and the EN 61000 series for EMC and global certification for Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

Proven experience with development and prototyping of electronic systems.

Knowledge of Python and/or C programming.

Enjoy working in diverse technical teams and sharing your knowledge.
